decision.reason: [ev-d9673d74f883] is a pre-upgrade check. It tells operators to make sure no `v1alpha1` resources are in use and to look through their manifests and tooling. It does not name the API group or the kinds whose v1alpha1 version is affected, so no applicability condition can be written for who is exposed. It also does not say what changed (for example, whether v1alpha1 was removed or stopped being served) or what happens if v1alpha1 resources are still in use. The section context only repeats this one item, so we need the rest of the 0.16 upgrade guide or the related CRD/API change notes to fill these gaps.
